categories.name: Allies
categories.description: Troops may be selected from any one of the following, Saxon and Wend (Slav) allies maybe taken after 790AD.  Lombard allies may be taken after 774 AD.  Saxon allies may be taken 785 AD. Wend (Slav) allies maybe taken after 709 AD.  Southern Slav allies may be taken after 801 AD. Arab alles may be taken if campaigning in Spain.  In this instance the Allies allwoance is reduced to 25%.

units.name: Rex, Duke or King
units.description: May ride a horse.

units.name: Charlemagne
units.description: May ride a horse. Has the Strategem rule (+50).

units.name: Dux or Comes
units.description: May ride a horse.

units.name: Scolae Guardsmen
units.description: Scolae Guardsmen have heavy armour, spear and shield. Superior Fighters. Drilled. Shock Cavalry.

units.name: Scara
units.description: Scara have heavy armour, spear and shield. Superior Fighters. Shock Cavalry.

units.name: Freemen Cavalry
units.description: Freemen Cavalry have spear and shield. Up to two units may have light armour (+1).  Armoured units may be Shock Cavalry (+4).

units.name: Dismounted Cavalry
units.description: Dismounted Cavalry have spear and shield. They may have light armour (+2). Up to two units may be Superior Fighters (+4).

units.name: Combined Formation Dismounted Cavalry
units.description: Dismounted Cavalry have spear and shield. They may have light armour (+2). Up to two units may be Superior Fighters (+4). Units of dismounted cavalry may use Combined Formation where up to 50% of figures exchange spearand shield for bow (free) and form the rear rows.

units.name: Light Cavalry
units.description: Light Cavalry have javelins, spear and shield. Inferior Fighters. May exchange javelins spear and shield for bow (-2).

units.name: Spearmen
units.description: Spearmen have a spear and shield. Shieldwall.

units.name: Archers
units.description: Archers have a bow. Open Order. Up to half of all archer units may be fielded as Skirmishers at a cost of seven points per base.

units.name: Combined Formation Spearmen/Archers
units.description: Spearmen have a spear and shield. Shieldwall. Archers have a bow. Combined Formation with spearmen and up to 50% archers making up the rear ranks

units.name: Eastern Franks
units.description: Eastern Franks have a spear and shield. Shieldwall.Warband.. May exchange spear for throwing spear (+2).

units.name: Gascon or Basque Javelinmen
units.description: Gascon or Basque Javelinmen have javelins. Inferior Fighters. Superior Shooters. Skirmishers. They may have shields (+1).

units.name: Breton Cavalry
units.description: Breton Cavalry have javelins, spear and shield. Superior Fighters. Evade. They may have light armour (+1).

units.name: Gascon or Basque Cavalry
units.description: Gascon or Basque  Cavalry have javelins and shield. Inferior Fighters. Evade. They may have spear(+1). May be fielded as Skirmishers at a cost of 15 points per base.
